context_budget_total.description: Workflow-level total context window budget in tokens (RFC 0008). When set (>0), the scheduler equal-splits the remainder across non-overridden steps after subtracting any per-step `context_budget` overrides, and the executor packages context for each dispatch. When unset or 0, packaging is disabled (legacy passthrough preserved).

timeout_seconds.description: Per-step wall-clock timeout in seconds. Minimum 1 when specified. Omit to inherit from agent config or system defaults.

max_llm_calls.description: Maximum LLM calls for this step. Minimum 1 when specified. Omit to inherit from agent config or system defaults.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens per LLM call for this step. Minimum 1 when specified. Omit to inherit from agent config or system defaults.

context_budget.description: Per-step context window budget in tokens (RFC 0008). 0 means inherit (equal-split from `workflow.context_budget_total`). Negative values are rejected at parse time.
